## One-Liner

> **SART detects and corrects shortcut learning in LLMs at training time — no prior knowledge of shortcut types required, no retraining, plugs into existing pipelines.**

## Summary Table

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Problem** | LLMs fail silently in production due to shortcut learning |
| **Solution** | Gradient-level detection + correction, single pass, no prior shortcut knowledge |
| **Differentiation** | Per-sample granularity; composable; no "train twice" |
| **Stage** | Research validated; NeurIPS 2026 submitted; real-world extension in progress |
| **Market entry** | Diagnostic API for ML teams; compliance tooling for regulated industries |
| **Key risk** | Compute cost at full scale; single-author dependency |
| **Key strength** | Production-grade codebase; 13-method benchmark; original algorithm |
